message:
"Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes (3 of 3).

The cause was in `vendor/slugify/index.js`, which deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`, so accented letters vanished instead of keeping their base letter. That file is marked "do not edit by hand", and the shop's `productUrl` also uses it, so I left it alone.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now decomposes the title (`normalize('NFD')`) and strips the combining accent marks before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs still drop accented letters, because I didn't touch that code. If you want it fixed too, the same change would go in `src/shop/product-url.js`.
